description: FC product session templates, explicit day-offset units and special hours under data contract v0.1. Date selects the exchange-local schedule; no real-time market status or prices. Missing prerequisites are unknown. Official exchange notices take precedence.

date.description: Valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, e.g. 2026-11-06, interpreted as the exchange-local trading date rather than UTC; omitted = today in the exchange/product time zone (UTC fallback if the zone is unavailable).

product.description: FC product slug with two alphanumeric segments separated by one hyphen, at most 40 characters, e.g. shfe-cu or nymex-cl; case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase, with no default when required.

name: trading_hours
